0022600036.text: The Miami Heat (5-6) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (6-6) in Miami's 12th game of the season, with the Heat eighth in the East and second in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, after winning their last two and going 5-5 over their last ten. Miami is 1-3 at home this season, while Cleveland is 2-4 on the road, has won its last game, and is 5-5 over its last ten, sitting sixth in the East and second in the Central, 2 games back. Sam Merrill is out for Cleveland with an elbow injury, and the teams have not met yet this season after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the most recent meeting a 149-128 Heat loss in Cleveland on March 27, 2026.
